title: Add idempotent payment capture endpoint
description:
## Problem
Duplicate capture requests can create duplicate downstream actions.

## Approach
Add an idempotency key check to the capture endpoint and persist prior outcomes.

## Acceptance Criteria
A repeated capture request with the same idempotency key returns the original response without a second capture.

## Test Evidence
Added API and service tests for repeated requests.

changed_files.summary: Adds idempotency check and prior result reuse.
